provenance.design: R8-1 (WS-216/ARCH-007, R8-F-020 + R7-CF-REPAIR): manifest-based classification + per-environment anchoring; gzip measured on deterministically normalized content (known hash filenames + build identity)
provenance.tolerances_derivation: raw +8 = 2x the max observed identity-driven minifier identifier-shift (delta 4, R8-0 section 4.3.3); gzip +16 = 2x the conservative post-normalization shift bound (observed convergence 0 on lazy/initial, 4 on normalized entry; R8-0 section 4.3.4); hard caps enforced by the guard (raw<=16, gzip<=256)
provenance.seed_note: R8-1 re-defines the surfaces semantically: lazy = dynamic-only closure from manifest isDynamicEntry roots (the replaced filename heuristic missed 14,228 B of genuinely lazy chunks and misattributed 224,687 B of initial-load chunks as lazy); precache counts UNIQUE URLs (the previous measurement double-counted 31 duplicate URLs generated by overlapping includeAssets/globPatterns globs, +76,466 B - recorded as finding R8-N1, separate track); the service-worker runtime surface (sw.js + workbox-*.js) is guarded for the first time (was an unclassified blind spot). Counts are recorded, not guarded. Entry ceilings 650,000/155,300 remain owned exclusively by check-bundle-budget (D-034/ADR-017). (Dated correction 2026-10-10, R8-N1 root fix on code head 7341f911 per owner decision FIX_NOW: the 31 duplicate URLs are now eliminated at the configuration root (includeAssets removed + includeManifestIcons:false - one canonical globPatterns selection path), sw.js carries each intended URL exactly once (187 -> 156 entries; unique set proven identical: lost=[] gained=[]), and duplicate precache URLs now fail the guard closed (DUPLICATE_PRECACHE_URLS) instead of being measured over - the old 'separate track' disposition is closed and superseded; swRuntimeRawTotal re-anchored 28,885 -> 26,170 below.)
provenance.history: W8 STR-608/F-11 (2026-10-05) original lazy+precache ratchet; W10 CI-environment gzip anchoring; R7-2/R7-3/R7-4 documented structural-growth updates; R7-CF-REPAIR +512 cross-environment interim bridge; R8-1 per-environment replacement (this schema); R8-N1 root-fix re-anchor (2026-10-10): swRuntimeRawTotal 28,885 -> 26,170 in all three environments (sw.js loses the 31 duplicate precache manifest entries; every other guarded surface byte-identical on the same code head). R9 continuation root-fix re-anchor (2026-10-10, code head 0bb51d1e): lazyRawTotal 1,206,629 -> 1,207,964 and lazyGzipNormTotal 363,974 -> 364,297 (page state machines + G5 key), precacheBytesTotal 2,672,292 -> 2,675,532 local / 2,675,644 cloud (the +1,905 entry delta from the storage listener hardening applies to the precache only — the entry ceilings remain owned by check-bundle-budget and hold at 631,254/155,009). R9 systemic continuation local per-group re-anchors (2026-10-11, Groups A-C: da8747ca lazy 1,210,965/365,037; ecc4b963 precache 2,678,905; ecf17620 precache 2,678,931 — entry 631,652/155,093). R9 systemic continuation post-push cloud re-anchor (2026-10-11, on the CI-measured values of head 67366bff): the two cloud records were left at the 0bb51d1e values when the local record was re-anchored per-group — the push exposed the gap (CI run 38118248772 + Pages check-run 114407518003 failed exactly the three grown surfaces); both cloud records now carry 1,210,965 / 365,037 / 2,679,043 (github-actions directly measured; cloudflare-pages by the environment-class derivation proven on the previous generation). R10-B2 RC-1 re-anchor (2026-10-11, code head 16108527): lazyRawTotal 1,210,965 -> 1,214,640 and lazyGzipNormTotal 365,037 -> 366,065 (array-family registry + current-pair raw gate + owner count keys), precacheBytesTotal 2,678,931 -> 2,682,606 local / 2,682,718 cloud (+112 identity footprint derivation); initial companions and swRuntime byte-identical; entry ceilings untouched. R10-B2 RV5 gate-fix re-anchor (2026-10-11, head dd1e320b): lazy 1,214,640 -> 1,214,850 / 366,065 -> 366,062; precache 2,682,606 -> 2,682,816 local / 2,682,928 cloud.
provenance.environment_convergence: all three environments measure identical normalized gzip on the same graph (lazyGzipNormTotal 365,037 and initialGzipNormTotal 70,716 in local, github-actions, and cloudflare-pages after the 2026-10-11 re-anchor; the previous generation converged at 363,974/70,716); raw surfaces are identical across environments for the non-entry files (lazy and initial companions carry no build identity — the failed 67366bff CI run measured lazy 1,210,965 byte-equal to local); the entry and precache differ by the +112 hex-identity footprint (local null-fallback vs CI/Pages 40-hex SHA: entry 631,652 -> 631,764, precache 2,678,931 -> 2,679,043); sw.js byte size is environment-invariant (revision digests are fixed-length hex — all three environments measured identical swRuntimeRawTotal 26,170 after the R8-N1 root fix; the final PR-head CI and Cloudflare Pages runs verify the two cloud records) After the R10-B2 re-anchor (2026-10-11): all three environments carry lazy 1,214,640 / 366,065 and initial 224,687 / 70,716; precache 2,682,606 local vs 2,682,718 cloud (+112 hex-identity footprint); the final PR-head CI and Cloudflare Pages runs verify the two cloud records.
